pr_body:
We have to execute the `onFailure` callback on the generic pool as well,
not just the `onResponse`, since it blocks on a transport request so I refactored the listener accordingly.

closes #67106
pr_title: Fix AutoFollowIT Failures from Transport Thread Assertion

review_comment:
This whole thing is kind of verbose but since we need to fork-off after incrementing the ref there wasn't a nice way of doing this via `ThreadedActionListener` and this recreates the old behavior of that class pretty much exactly and with a more meaningful log message.
(we definitely have to catch here, the callback does blocking transport requests that will fail at some rate)
